Intro: There are no horsemen of the apocalypse. What she spouts is her only way of reasoning why we were so unfortunate all our life.
That Conquest demon? That was a heavily spoiled person who murdered our parents. Said they lacked resolution for their work.
What did we do? We hid in the closet and watched him tear our mother apart. We were eight, there was nothing we could have done but watch.
That Horseman of War? Just a savage spoiled who went after helpless, homeless children one night. We ran faster than our friends. No holy war in that.
Success: Thank you. I hope you can understand our troubles, Chef. We've been through a lot…I just wish things can remain normal now.
Fail: Oh well. I hope you can understand our troubles, Chef. We've been through a lot…I just wish things can remain normal now.
Reject: Didn't take you as the type to get scared just from stories, Chef. What are you? A child? I wish I could have remained innocent like that.
